source_of_record: Wisconsin Department of Administration Municipal Data System (MDS)
scope: County-set delta records in Wisconsin 2020 to 2026 census replay

evidence.observed_delta: 2020 vs 2026 Census county-set change; exact before/after sets in CI artifact
evidence.source_statement: MDS comments state first Lake Hallie annexation into Eau Claire County from Town of Seymour; prior jurisdiction only in Chippewa County

evidence.limitation: 2022 Menasha-to-Fox-Crossing transfer in Winnebago County does not itself prove separate new county edge; match exact changed county and ordinance geometry
Road right-of-way / detachment-attachment records require independent polygon and timing check before comparing 2020 and 2026 county sets

rules: Only official state MDS HTML records were evaluated in this pass
MDS record validates reported legal event; source accuracy and legal effect require detailed document verification
Do not infer causation from shared GEOID or presence of ordinance alone
No polygon geometry overlay of legal description to Census boundary in this checkpoint
Source page URLs are evidence pointers, not exact-byte SHA256 for the ordinance PDFs
Never equate Wisconsin MDS annexor and annexee labels with Census place-to-county mapping without verification
